title: Startup, connection retirement, close/reopen, and explicit quit

requirements.initial: The app window and a Workspace task are active.
requirements.action: Close the window and reopen via Dock/tray.
requirements.expected: The same window/Session returns and the owned backend keeps running.

evidence.assertion: hides an ordinary close without destroying the window or quitting the app
restores the hidden window when the macOS Dock activates the app
evidence.scope: Synthetic activate event; no real Dock.

evidence.assertion: uses the same restoration path for the tray
evidence.scope: Direct restoration helper; no native tray click.

requirements.gap: Real macOS and Windows close/reopen with an active Session must be accepted separately.

requirements.action: Close or activate the window while resources are being released.
requirements.expected: The app exits cleanly and activation cannot reopen it.

evidence.assertion: allows the window to close when explicit app shutdown has started
evidence.scope: Controlled quitting flag; no child-process cleanup.

evidence.assertion: does not reopen a window during shutdown

requirements.gap: Owned PTY/service cleanup after native menu Quit and the close/quit race lack mapped native evidence.

requirements.initial: Desktop has an explicit Home or a legacy competing startup preference.
requirements.expected: Explicit automation bypasses native preferences; competing controller policy cannot save/relaunch.

evidence.assertion: does not read real launcher preferences for an explicit automation home
keeps legacy controller methods from saving a competing startup policy

requirements.gap: Actual Desktop main startup ordering and chooser/default save not accepted natively.

requirements.initial: The selected Home has an existing healthy or stale owner.
requirements.expected: Healthy dev handoff quits Desktop without takeover; cancelling stale dialog preserves owner.

evidence.assertion: defaults a healthy dev owner to Open in browser, then quits without takeover
quits without takeover when Esc cancels a stale-owner dialog

requirements.gap: Obtain existing-owner native smoke separately, plus manual chooser transition.

requirements.action: Retire the child before switching Project.
requirements.expected: Old requests reject rather than leaking into replacement child.

evidence.assertion: cancels in-flight requests before the local Alice child is retired
evidence.scope: Mock child IPC/request map; also referenced by desktop-ipc.

requirements.gap: Real renderer/preload cancellation/reattachment remains native gap.

requirements.initial: Shutdown starts with a child that accepted SIGTERM without exiting.
requirements.action: Wait grace period and force stop; request app exit.
requirements.expected: Force is used only if required and app hard-exit fallback is unrefed.

evidence.assertion: forces a child that accepted SIGTERM but did not exit
evidence.scope: FakeChild and injected signals; not OS cleanup.

evidence.assertion: requests Electron exit and arms an unrefed hard-exit fallback
does not force a child that exits during the SIGTERM grace period
evidence.scope: FakeChild and injected signals; no OS cleanup.

requirements.gap: Native menu Quit, PTY/service/port/process tree completion and close/quit race require separate acceptance.

requirements.initial: The smoke-owned wrapper exits while helpers or a zombie thread-group leader remain.
requirements.action: Stop the private process group, escalating only while members may execute.
requirements.expected: Live TERM-ignoring helpers receive KILL; only stable exited single-thread zombies establish completion.

evidence.assertion: terminates a %s helper after the parent exits
evidence.scope: Real POSIX Node helpers in a private group, including ignored TERM and legal adversarial process names; no Electron.

evidence.assertion: keeps state %s with thread count %s live
evidence.scope: Synthetic procfs states including a Z leader with executing workers or unknown thread count.

evidence.assertion: retains live children forked between the directory snapshot and zombie read
evidence.scope: Injected procfs snapshots; incomplete/racing evidence remains conservative.

requirements.gap: Native Electron Quit, packaged service/port cleanup, Windows taskkill and macOS group semantics require separate acceptance. Optional native pthread diagnostic is local evidence, not a mandatory compiler dependency.
